title: PRODIGE 115 (FFCD 2406) ULYSSE : FOLFOX/FOLFIRI + Bévacizumab ou Fruquintinib en 2ème ligne du Cancer Colorectal métastatique (CCRm) : essai de phase II randomisée non comparative ULYSSE (PRODIGE 115 – FFCD 2406)
official: PRODIGE 115 (FFCD 2406) ULYSSE : A phase II, open-label, non-comparative, randomized study of second-line doublet chemotherapy (FOLFOX or FOLFIRI) plus Fruquintinib versus doublet chemotherapy (FOLFOX or FOLFIRI) plus Bevacizumab in metastatic colorectal cancer
summary: Main objective: Disease Control Rate (DCR) assessed 4 months after the start of treatment

interventions.name: Avastin 25 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years and ≤ 80 years; provided the score of the G8 geriatric questionnaire is >14 for patients 75 years or older
2. Patients must have previously received first-line therapy with Bevacizumab or an EGFRi, in combination with either FOLFOX or FOLFIRI, for non-resectable mCRC. Patients who progressed during the adjuvant chemotherapy (FOLFOX) or within the 6 months following its completion are eligible for inclusion
3. Patients must have an unresectable tumor at the time of enrollment
4. Patients must have at least one measurable/evaluable metastatic lesion according to RECIST v1.1 criteria; images have to be available for collection
5. Metastases not amenable to surgery and/or thermo-ablation and/or stereotaxic radiotherapy
6. WHO performance status 0 or 1
7. Available parameters to compute the SPOD score: WHO PS, hemoglobin, platelet count, WBC/absolute neutrophil count ratio, lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), alkaline phosphatase, and the number of metastatic sites.
8. Adequate liver functions: Total Bilirubinemia < 1,5 ULN, AST and ALT ≤ 3 ULN
9. BRAF V600E wild type tumor
10. MSS/pMMR tumor
11. Adequate hematological (Hemoglobin ≥10g/dL, platelets ≥100G/L, neutrophils ≥1.5G/L) and renal (creatinine clearance ≥ 50 mL/min according to CKD-EPI) functions
12. Proteinuria < 2+ (dipstick urinalysis) (if 2+ or more, proteinuria must be ≤1g/24hour)
13. Life expectancy ≥ 3 months
14. Women of childbearing potential must agree to use a highly effective method of contraception during the trial and for at least 15 months after discontinuation of the experimental treatments. Men who have sexual relations with women of childbearing potential must agree to use contraception during treatment and for at least 12 months after discontinuation of the experimental treatments
15. Ability of the patient to understand, sign and date the information note and informed consent form before any study specific procedures
16. Patient affiliated to a social security scheme
17. Available tumor sample and pathology report for collection
18. Patients with a histologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC), with a documented disease progression (as per RECIST v1.1, assessed by the investigator and confirmed through CT or MRI).
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients who have received more than one prior systemic therapy
2. Strong inducers of CYP3A4 (treatment with St John’s Wort (Hypericum perforatum), fampicin, phenobarbital, primidone, phenytoin and carbamazepine)
3. Strong inhibitors of CYP3A4, continuous use of azole antifungals (posaconazole, voriconazole, itraconazole, isavuconazole), ritonavir, verapamil, diltiazem, grapefruit juice (equivalent to half a fresh grapefruit/day)
4. FOLFIRINOX Regimen +/- targeted therapy in the first line setting
5. Concomitant or recent treatment with sorivudine or its analogs (including brivudine) within 4 weeks prior to the administration of protocol treatment (related to Fluorouracil)
6. QT/QTc interval > 450 ms for men and > 470 ms for women
7. Uncontrolled hypertension (defined as systolic blood pressure >140 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure >90 mmHg) or history of hypertensive crisis (TA systolic> 20 mmHg) or hypertensive encephalopathy
8. History of veinous thromboembolic events, including deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism, within the past month prior to study enrollment
9. History of stroke and/or transient ischemic attack (TIA) within the past 12 months
10. Persistent toxicities related to prior treatment of grade greater than 1
11. Persistence of clinically significant symptoms after a thromboembolic event despite anticoagulant treatment
12. Hypersensitivity to one of the study drugs or one of its excipients
13. Arterial thromboembolism (myocardial infarction, stroke, transient ischemic attack) occurring under antiangiogenic therapy
14. Other active cancers or history of cancer treated within the last 5 years except for carcinoma in situ of the cervix or basal cell or squamous cell skin carcinoma or any other carcinoma in situ, considered cured
15. Unknown RAS status
16. Persons deprived of liberty or under guardianship or unable of giving consent
17. Inability to undergo the medical follow-up of the trial for geographical, social or psychological reasons
18. Known brain metastasis
19. Known peritoneal carcinomatosis if there are signs of clinical occlusion or sub-occlusion
20. History of gastric ulceration, or myocardial infarction, or severe coronaropathy or severe cardiac dysfunction, within the past 6 months prior to treatment start
21. Patients with dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase deficiency (uracilemia ≥ 16 ng/mL)
22. According the SmPC of bevacizumab: hypersensitivity to Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cell products or other recombinant human or humanised antibodies; gastrointestinal perforation
23. Inability to swallow capsules
24. According the SmPC of irinotecan, in case of chronic inflammatory bowel disease and/or bowel obstruction,
25. According the SmPC of oxaliplatine: in case of peripheral sensory neuropathy with functional impairment prior to first treatment, in case of hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia or hypocalcemia, given the cardiotoxicity of treatment with oxaliplatin (risk of prolongation of QT [see section 4.4. of oxaliplatin SmPC])
26. According to section 4.3 of the SmPC of 5-fluorouracil: potentially serious infection, patients with poor nutritional status
27. Live attenuated vaccines 30 days prior to treatment start
28. Untreated bone fracture
29. Significant haemorrhagic diathesis or coagulopathy (in the absence of anti-coagulant treatment)
30. Major surgery, open biopsy or major traumatic lesion in the prior 30 days, or the need for major surgery during the trial
31. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman or patients with no adequate contraception
32. Known Uridine Diphosphate Glucuronyltransferase (UGT1A1) deficiency or known Gilbert disease
